name: Cybernetic Hi-School Part 4 ~Ape Hunter J~
original_name: 電脳学園４ ～エイプハンターＪ～
source:
In 2006 the people had just one anxiety - "Monkey". Elimination of ozone layer by ultraviolet rays after 1980s caused ape mutation evolution. Mutants were intelligent and since they started to look like humans they secretly infiltrated human society. Thus appeared ape hunters - specialists in identification and "processing" of monkeys.

You are such an ape hunter and you've just received a request from school director to reveal monkeys in the school. The only way to check it is undress the subject and find evidence of his red ass and tail.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2006年，人类只有一个忧患——“猿猴”。20世纪80年代以后，臭氧层遭到破坏，紫外线促使猿类发生突变与进化。变异猿拥有智慧，外表也逐渐酷似人类，于是开始秘密渗透人类社会。专门识别并“处理”猿猴的职业由此诞生，人们称他们为猎猿人。

你正是一名猎猿人，刚刚受校长委托，要找出潜伏在学校里的猿猴。确认目标身份只有一个办法：脱光对方的衣服，检查是否藏着红屁股和尾巴。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
